Research

My research develops statistical methods for structured, high-dimensional, and functional data.

Online and functional methods

The onlinePCA project develops algorithms for online principal component analysis, including recursive updates of means, covariances, and principal directions.

Segmentation and sparse estimation

The sparseGFL project studies sparse group fused lasso methods for joint model segmentation and sparse estimation in high-dimensional piecewise regression models.

Switching and multiblock models

The switch-ssm and tensorMCCA projects address Markov-switching state-space models and tensor-based multiple canonical correlation analysis.

Functional inference and neuroimaging

Related work includes simultaneous confidence bands for functional data, statistical computing, convex and combinatorial optimization, and applications in neuroimaging.
